nuggets.text: The Panthers' 59-10 opening win over North Carolina A&T set program records for points and margin of victory.
Seven different Panthers scored a touchdown in the 59-10 rout of North Carolina A&T.
The Panthers play in Center Parc Stadium, built as the 1996 Olympic Stadium and later the Braves' Turner Field.
The Panthers played their first game in 2010 at the Georgia Dome, beating Shorter 41-7 in front of 30,237 fans.
Dell McGee played cornerback at Auburn and was a fifth-round NFL draft pick of the Arizona Cardinals in 1996.
Dell McGee won two national titles as Georgia's running backs coach before taking over the Panthers in 2024.
Panthers receiver Austin McGee is the son of head coach Dell McGee.
The Panthers won the only previous meeting with the Owls, 24-20 in 2018, with a late fourth-quarter comeback.
The Panthers' first head coach was Bill Curry, who had previously coached Georgia Tech, Alabama and Kentucky.
The Panthers beat Tennessee on the road in 2019, then topped SEC foe Vanderbilt 36-32 in 2024.
